Poetic form: Acrostic
The initial letters of successive lines spell a name, word, or phrase. The vertical reading adds a second structure to the horizontal one.
provenance: Original concise explanatory note for Inspire, 2026; conventional form facts checked 2026-10-13 against https://poets.org/glossary/acrostic . Reference definitions paraphrased; no example poems copied. Poetry Foundation pages consulted through indexed search excerpts; Academy of American Poets pages consulted in full. Form descriptions are typical patterns, not claims that every poem uses them without variation.
